context: DOC-C §15.2 UI critical flows required as browser E2E
cause: Layered startup integration faults: web source resolution, runtime-specific Node imports, DSN query assembly, and bootstrap schema mapping.
failed_approach: Rely on static/type tests and generic bundler aliasing without executing the Next server in a real browser gate.
recovery: Drive fixes from GitHub browser job logs until startup, migration prep, Playwright assertions, and evidence attestation all pass on one SHA.
boundary: Do not weaken/skip browser E2E, migration proof, or release-attestation dependencies to obtain green CI.
prevention: Mandatory UI browser job; runtime-scoped instrumentation; DSN regression tests; mapped-field bootstrap tests.
